rca of the issue: Root cause of the M6 progress 422: when the recruitment course was remapped from 5→6 modules (course_content.py SELF_GUIDED_MODULES/BASIC_MODULES now length 6, migration six_module_recruitment_v1 already applied to DB), the Pydantic validators in course_routes.py were not updated in lockstep. Three models still enforced le=5 on module_number: ProgressRequest (line 17), SupportRequestCreate (line 38), VideoConfig (line 60). The merged_course reader tolerated 6 correctly (uses len(modules)), and track_progress had already been updated to use total=6 for recruitment when counting completions — but the *validator* rejected the very payload the UI needs to send when the user completes module 6. Impact: any recruitment user completing Module 6 or an admin setting the Module 6 video would see 422 errors; support requests filed against Module 6 would 422; frontend START STEP 6 completion would silently fail. Mitigation applied: three-line edit to change le=5 → le=6. Longer-term fix: centralize the module-count constant in course_content.py (e.g. RECRUITMENT_MODULE_COUNT=6, REACTIVATION_MODULE_COUNT=5) and consume it in every ge/le validator so future remaps only touch one line.
